title.zh-CN: 第1课：数学环境与基础语法

description.zh-CN: 学习LaTeX数学公式的基础语法，掌握数学环境、上标、下标的使用方法。
description.en-US: Learn the basic syntax of LaTeX mathematical formulas, master the use of math environments, superscripts, and subscripts.

content.zh-CN:
**LaTeX数学环境**

LaTeX数学公式需要在特定环境中编写：

• **行内公式**：使用 `$...$` 包围，如 `$x^2$` → $x^2$
• **独立公式**：使用 `$$...$$` 包围，如 `$$E = mc^2$$` → $$E = mc^2$$
content.en-US:
**LaTeX Math Environment**

LaTeX mathematical formulas need to be written in specific environments:

• **Inline formulas**: Use `$...$` to surround, e.g., `$x^2$` → $x^2$
• **Display formulas**: Use `$$...$$` to surround, e.g., `$$E = mc^2$$` → $$E = mc^2$$

**Superscripts and Subscripts**

• Superscripts use `^` symbol: `$x^2$` → $x^2$
• Subscripts use `_` symbol: `$x_1$` → $x_1$
• Combined use: `$x_1^2$` → $x_1^2$

content.zh-CN:
**多字符上下标与分数中的上下标**

当上标或下标包含多个字符时，必须用花括号包围：

• `$x_{10}$` → $x_{10}$（下标是 n+1 这类表达式时同理）
• `$e^{-x}$` → $e^{-x}$
• 明确的写法：`$x_{n}^{2}$` → $x_{n}^{2}$
• 分数中同样适用：`$\frac{x^2}{y_1}$` → $\frac{x^2}{y_1}$
content.en-US:
**Multi-character Scripts & Scripts in Fractions**

When a superscript or subscript contains multiple characters, wrap it in curly braces:

• `$x_{10}$` → $x_{10}$ (same for expressions like n+1)
• `$e^{-x}$` → $e^{-x}$
• Explicit form: `$x_{n}^{2}$` → $x_{n}^{2}$
• Also applies inside fractions: `$\frac{x^2}{y_1}$` → $\frac{x^2}{y_1}$

description.zh-CN: 学习如何在LaTeX中表示分数和根号，掌握复杂数学表达式的写法。
description.en-US: Learn how to represent fractions and radicals in LaTeX, master complex mathematical expressions.

content.en-US:
**Fraction Notation**

Use `\frac{numerator}{denominator}` command:

• `$\frac{1}{2}$` → $\frac{1}{2}$
• `$\frac{a+b}{c-d}$` → $\frac{a+b}{c-d}$
• `$\frac{x^2}{y^3}$` → $\frac{x^2}{y^3}$

content.zh-CN:
**根号表示法**

使用 `\sqrt{}` 命令：

• `$\sqrt{x}$` → $\sqrt{x}$ (平方根)
• `$\sqrt[3]{x}$` → $\sqrt[3]{x}$ (三次根)
• `$\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}$` → $\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}$
content.en-US:
**Radical Notation**

Use `\sqrt{}` command:

• `$\sqrt{x}$` → $\sqrt{x}$ (square root)
• `$\sqrt[3]{x}$` → $\sqrt[3]{x}$ (cube root)
• `$\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}$` → $\sqrt{x^2 + y^2}$

content.zh-CN:
**分数的其他写法**

• 行间显示用 `\dfrac`：`$\dfrac{a}{b}$` → $\dfrac{a}{b}$
• 分数可以嵌套：`$\frac{\frac{1}{2}}{3}$` → $\frac{\frac{1}{2}}{3}$
• 连分数写法：`$$1 + \frac{1}{2 + \frac{1}{3}}$$` → $$1 + \frac{1}{2 + \frac{1}{3}}$$
content.en-US:
**Other Fraction Forms**

• Use `\dfrac` for display-style fractions: `$\dfrac{a}{b}$` → $\dfrac{a}{b}$
• Fractions can nest: `$\frac{\frac{1}{2}}{3}$` → $\frac{\frac{1}{2}}{3}$
• Continued fraction: `$$1 + \frac{1}{2 + \frac{1}{3}}$$` → $$1 + \frac{1}{2 + \frac{1}{3}}$$

content.zh-CN:
**根号的组合与嵌套**

• n 次根号：`$\sqrt[n]{x}$` → $\sqrt[n]{x}$
• 根号下可以有复杂表达式：`$\sqrt{a^2 + b^2}$` → $\sqrt{a^2 + b^2}$
• 根号嵌套：`$\sqrt{\sqrt{x}}$` → $\sqrt{\sqrt{x}}$
• 分数与根号结合：`$\frac{\sqrt{x}}{2}$` → $\frac{\sqrt{x}}{2}$
content.en-US:
**Combining & Nesting Radicals**

• nth root: `$\sqrt[n]{x}$` → $\sqrt[n]{x}$
• Complex expressions under the root: `$\sqrt{a^2 + b^2}$` → $\sqrt{a^2 + b^2}$
• Nested radicals: `$\sqrt{\sqrt{x}}$` → $\sqrt{\sqrt{x}}$
• Fractions with radicals: `$\frac{\sqrt{x}}{2}$` → $\frac{\sqrt{x}}{2}$

title.zh-CN: 第3课：希腊字母与常用符号

description.zh-CN: 学习常用的希腊字母和数学符号的LaTeX写法，为高级数学公式打基础。
description.en-US: Learn LaTeX notation for common Greek letters and mathematical symbols, laying foundation for advanced formulas.

content.zh-CN:
**常用小写希腊字母**

• `$\alpha$` → $\alpha$ (阿尔法)
• `$\beta$` → $\beta$ (贝塔)
• `$\gamma$` → $\gamma$ (伽马)
• `$\delta$` → $\delta$ (德尔塔)
• `$\pi$` → $\pi$ (派)
• `$\theta$` → $\theta$ (西塔)
• `$\lambda$` → $\lambda$ (兰姆达)
• `$\mu$` → $\mu$ (缪)
content.en-US:
**Common Lowercase Greek Letters**

• `$\alpha$` → $\alpha$ (alpha)
• `$\beta$` → $\beta$ (beta)
• `$\gamma$` → $\gamma$ (gamma)
• `$\delta$` → $\delta$ (delta)
• `$\pi$` → $\pi$ (pi)
• `$\theta$` → $\theta$ (theta)
• `$\lambda$` → $\lambda$ (lambda)
• `$\mu$` → $\mu$ (mu)

content.zh-CN:
**常用大写希腊字母**

• `$\Gamma$` → $\Gamma$ (大伽马)
• `$\Delta$` → $\Delta$ (大德尔塔)
• `$\Theta$` → $\Theta$ (大西塔)
• `$\Lambda$` → $\Lambda$ (大兰姆达)
• `$\Pi$` → $\Pi$ (大派)
• `$\Sigma$` → $\Sigma$ (大西格马)
• `$\Omega$` → $\Omega$ (大欧米伽)
content.en-US:
**Common Uppercase Greek Letters**

• `$\Gamma$` → $\Gamma$ (Gamma)
• `$\Delta$` → $\Delta$ (Delta)
• `$\Theta$` → $\Theta$ (Theta)
• `$\Lambda$` → $\Lambda$ (Lambda)
• `$\Pi$` → $\Pi$ (Pi)
• `$\Sigma$` → $\Sigma$ (Sigma)
• `$\Omega$` → $\Omega$ (Omega)

content.zh-CN:
**常用数学符号**

• `$\infty$` → $\infty$ (无穷)
• `$\pm$` → $\pm$ (正负)
• `$\times$` → $\times$ (乘号)
• `$\div$` → $\div$ (除号)
• `$\neq$` → $\neq$ (不等于)
• `$\leq$` → $\leq$ (小于等于)
• `$\geq$` → $\geq$ (大于等于)
• `$\approx$` → $\approx$ (约等于)
content.en-US:
**Common Mathematical Symbols**

• `$\infty$` → $\infty$ (infinity)
• `$\pm$` → $\pm$ (plus/minus)
• `$\times$` → $\times$ (multiplication)
• `$\div$` → $\div$ (division)
• `$\neq$` → $\neq$ (not equal)
• `$\leq$` → $\leq$ (less than or equal)
• `$\geq$` → $\geq$ (greater than or equal)
• `$\approx$` → $\approx$ (approximately equal)

content.zh-CN:
**符号在表达式中的使用**

• 正负号：`$x \pm 2$` → $x \pm 2$
• 乘除号：`$2 \times 3$`、`$a \div b$` → $2 \times 3$、$a \div b$
• 约等于：`$\pi \approx 3.14$` → $\pi \approx 3.14$
• 希腊字母与符号可以组合：`$\theta \times \pi$` → $\theta \times \pi$
content.en-US:
**Using Symbols in Expressions**

• Plus/minus: `$x \pm 2$` → $x \pm 2$
• Multiplication and division: `$2 \times 3$`, `$a \div b$` → $2 \times 3$, $a \div b$
• Approximately equal: `$\pi \approx 3.14$` → $\pi \approx 3.14$
• Greek letters and symbols can combine: `$\theta \times \pi$` → $\theta \times \pi$

description.zh-CN: 学习函数表示法、三角函数、对数函数等常用数学函数的LaTeX写法。
description.en-US: Learn LaTeX notation for function representation, trigonometric functions, logarithmic functions and other common mathematical functions.

content.zh-CN:
**函数表示法**

• `$f(x)$` → $f(x)$ (函数)
• `$\sin x$` → $\sin x$ (正弦)
• `$\cos x$` → $\cos x$ (余弦)
• `$\tan x$` → $\tan x$ (正切)
• `$\log x$` → $\log x$ (对数)
• `$\ln x$` → $\ln x$ (自然对数)
• `$\exp x$` → $\exp x$ (指数函数)
content.en-US:
**Function Notation**

• `$f(x)$` → $f(x)$ (function)
• `$\sin x$` → $\sin x$ (sine)
• `$\cos x$` → $\cos x$ (cosine)
• `$\tan x$` → $\tan x$ (tangent)
• `$\log x$` → $\log x$ (logarithm)
• `$\ln x$` → $\ln x$ (natural logarithm)
• `$\exp x$` → $\exp x$ (exponential function)

content.zh-CN:
**复合函数与反函数**

• `$f(g(x))$` → $f(g(x))$ (复合函数)
• `$f^{-1}(x)$` → $f^{-1}(x)$ (反函数)
• `$\sin^2 x$` → $\sin^2 x$ (正弦平方)
• `$\arcsin x$` → $\arcsin x$ (反正弦)
• `$\arccos x$` → $\arccos x$ (反余弦)
• `$\arctan x$` → $\arctan x$ (反正切)
content.en-US:
**Composite Functions & Inverse Functions**

• `$f(g(x))$` → $f(g(x))$ (composite function)
• `$f^{-1}(x)$` → $f^{-1}(x)$ (inverse function)
• `$\sin^2 x$` → $\sin^2 x$ (sine squared)
• `$\arcsin x$` → $\arcsin x$ (arcsine)
• `$\arccos x$` → $\arccos x$ (arccosine)
• `$\arctan x$` → $\arctan x$ (arctangent)

content.zh-CN:
**对数与指数函数的写法**

• 带底数的对数：`$\log_2 x$` → $\log_2 x$（下标写底数）
• 自然对数：`$\ln(1+x)$` → $\ln(1+x)$
• 指数函数：`$\exp(-x)$` → $\exp(-x)$，等价于 $e^{-x}$
• 函数幂次写在命令名之后：`$\sin^2 x$` → $\sin^2 x$
• 反函数用 -1 次幂：`$f^{-1}(x)$` → $f^{-1}(x)$
content.en-US:
**Writing Logarithms & Exponential Functions**

• Logarithm with a base: `$\log_2 x$` → $\log_2 x$ (the base goes in the subscript)
• Natural logarithm: `$\ln(1+x)$` → $\ln(1+x)$
• Exponential function: `$\exp(-x)$` → $\exp(-x)$, equivalent to $e^{-x}$
• Function powers come right after the command: `$\sin^2 x$` → $\sin^2 x$
• Inverse functions use the -1 power: `$f^{-1}(x)$` → $f^{-1}(x)$

description.zh-CN: 学习求和符号、积分符号、极限符号等高级数学记号的LaTeX表示方法。
description.en-US: Learn LaTeX representation of summation symbols, integral symbols, limit symbols and other advanced mathematical notations.

content.zh-CN:
**求和符号**

• `$\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i$` → $\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i$ (有限求和)
• `$\sum_{k=0}^{\infty} \frac{1}{k!}$` → $\sum_{k=0}^{\infty} \frac{1}{k!}$ (无穷级数)
• `$\prod_{i=1}^{n} a_i$` → $\prod_{i=1}^{n} a_i$ (连乘)
content.en-US:
**Summation Symbols**

• `$\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i$` → $\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i$ (finite sum)
• `$\sum_{k=0}^{\infty} \frac{1}{k!}$` → $\sum_{k=0}^{\infty} \frac{1}{k!}$ (infinite series)
• `$\prod_{i=1}^{n} a_i$` → $\prod_{i=1}^{n} a_i$ (product)

content.zh-CN:
**积分符号**

• `$\int f(x) dx$` → $\int f(x) dx$ (不定积分)
• `$\int_0^1 x^2 dx$` → $\int_0^1 x^2 dx$ (定积分)
• `$\iint f(x,y) dx dy$` → $\iint f(x,y) dx dy$ (二重积分)
• `$\oint f(x) dx$` → $\oint f(x) dx$ (环积分)
content.en-US:
**Integral Symbols**

• `$\int f(x) dx$` → $\int f(x) dx$ (indefinite integral)
• `$\int_0^1 x^2 dx$` → $\int_0^1 x^2 dx$ (definite integral)
• `$\iint f(x,y) dx dy$` → $\iint f(x,y) dx dy$ (double integral)
• `$\oint f(x) dx$` → $\oint f(x) dx$ (contour integral)

content.zh-CN:
**极限符号**

• `$\lim_{x \to 0} f(x)$` → $\lim_{x \to 0} f(x)$ (极限)
• `$\lim_{n \to \infty} a_n$` → $\lim_{n \to \infty} a_n$ (数列极限)
• `$\lim_{x \to a^+} f(x)$` → $\lim_{x \to a^+} f(x)$ (右极限)
• `$\lim_{x \to a^-} f(x)$` → $\lim_{x \to a^-} f(x)$ (左极限)
content.en-US:
**Limit Symbols**

• `$\lim_{x \to 0} f(x)$` → $\lim_{x \to 0} f(x)$ (limit)
• `$\lim_{n \to \infty} a_n$` → $\lim_{n \to \infty} a_n$ (sequence limit)
• `$\lim_{x \to a^+} f(x)$` → $\lim_{x \to a^+} f(x)$ (right limit)
• `$\lim_{x \to a^-} f(x)$` → $\lim_{x \to a^-} f(x)$ (left limit)

content.zh-CN:
**上下限与趋向的组合示例**

• `$\sum_{k=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{2^k} = 1$` → $\sum_{k=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{2^k} = 1$ (无穷等比级数求和)
• `$\int_a^b f(x) dx$` → $\int_a^b f(x) dx$ (一般上下限的定积分)
• `$x \to \infty$` → $x \to \infty$ (x 趋向无穷大)
• `$\lim_{n \to \infty} \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^n = e$` → $\lim_{n \to \infty} \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^n = e$ (e 的极限定义)
content.en-US:
**Combined Examples of Bounds & Trends**

• `$\sum_{k=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{2^k} = 1$` → $\sum_{k=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{2^k} = 1$ (sum of an infinite geometric series)
• `$\int_a^b f(x) dx$` → $\int_a^b f(x) dx$ (definite integral with general bounds)
• `$x \to \infty$` → $x \to \infty$ (x tends to infinity)
• `$\lim_{n \to \infty} \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^n = e$` → $\lim_{n \to \infty} \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^n = e$ (limit definition of e)

description.zh-CN: 学习矩阵、向量、行列式等线性代数符号的LaTeX表示方法。
description.en-US: Learn LaTeX representation of matrices, vectors, determinants and other linear algebra symbols.

content.zh-CN:
**矩阵表示法**

• `$$\begin{matrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{matrix}$$` → $$\begin{matrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{matrix}$$ (基础矩阵)
• `$$\begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix}$$` → $$\begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix}$$ (圆括号矩阵)
• `$$\begin{bmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{bmatrix}$$` → $$\begin{bmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{bmatrix}$$ (方括号矩阵)
• `$$\begin{vmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{vmatrix}$$` → $$\begin{vmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{vmatrix}$$ (行列式)
content.en-US:
**Matrix Notation**

• `$$\begin{matrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{matrix}$$` → $$\begin{matrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{matrix}$$ (basic matrix)
• `$$\begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix}$$` → $$\begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix}$$ (parentheses matrix)
• `$$\begin{bmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{bmatrix}$$` → $$\begin{bmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{bmatrix}$$ (brackets matrix)
• `$$\begin{vmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{vmatrix}$$` → $$\begin{vmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{vmatrix}$$ (determinant)

content.zh-CN:
**向量表示法**

• `$\vec{v}$` → $\vec{v}$ (向量箭头)
• `$\mathbf{v}$` → $\mathbf{v}$ (粗体向量)
• `$\overrightarrow{AB}$` → $\overrightarrow{AB}$ (有向线段)
• `$\hat{i}$` → $\hat{i}$ (单位向量)
• `$\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}$` → $\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}$ (点积)
• `$\vec{a} \times \vec{b}$` → $\vec{a} \times \vec{b}$ (叉积)
content.en-US:
**Vector Notation**

• `$\vec{v}$` → $\vec{v}$ (vector arrow)
• `$\mathbf{v}$` → $\mathbf{v}$ (bold vector)
• `$\overrightarrow{AB}$` → $\overrightarrow{AB}$ (directed line segment)
• `$\hat{i}$` → $\hat{i}$ (unit vector)
• `$\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}$` → $\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}$ (dot product)
• `$\vec{a} \times \vec{b}$` → $\vec{a} \times \vec{b}$ (cross product)

content.zh-CN:
**矩阵运算与特殊矩阵**

• `$A^T$` → $A^T$ (矩阵转置)
• `$$\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}$$` → $$\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}$$ (2×2 单位矩阵)
• `$$\begin{pmatrix} x \\ y \\ z \end{pmatrix}$$` → $$\begin{pmatrix} x \\ y \\ z \end{pmatrix}$$ (三维列向量)
• `$k\vec{v}$` → $k\vec{v}$ (标量乘法)
content.en-US:
**Matrix Operations & Special Matrices**

• `$A^T$` → $A^T$ (matrix transpose)
• `$$\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}$$` → $$\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}$$ (2×2 identity matrix)
• `$$\begin{pmatrix} x \\ y \\ z \end{pmatrix}$$` → $$\begin{pmatrix} x \\ y \\ z \end{pmatrix}$$ (3D column vector)
• `$k\vec{v}$` → $k\vec{v}$ (scalar multiplication)

content.zh-CN:
**向量运算记号**

• `$\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}$` → $\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}$ (点积，结果为标量)
• `$\vec{a} \times \vec{b}$` → $\vec{a} \times \vec{b}$ (叉积，结果为向量)
• `$\mathbf{u} + \mathbf{v}$` → $\mathbf{u} + \mathbf{v}$ (粗体向量相加)
content.en-US:
**Vector Operation Notation**

• `$\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}$` → $\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}$ (dot product, result is a scalar)
• `$\vec{a} \times \vec{b}$` → $\vec{a} \times \vec{b}$ (cross product, result is a vector)
• `$\mathbf{u} + \mathbf{v}$` → $\mathbf{u} + \mathbf{v}$ (bold vectors added)

description.zh-CN: 学习方程组、不等式组、条件表达式等复杂数学结构的LaTeX表示。
description.en-US: Learn LaTeX representation of equation systems, inequality systems, conditional expressions and other complex mathematical structures.

content.zh-CN:
**方程组表示法**

• `$$\begin{cases} x + y = 1 \\ x - y = 0 \end{cases}$$` → $$\begin{cases} x + y = 1 \\ x - y = 0 \end{cases}$$ (二元方程组)
• `$$\begin{aligned} x + y &= 1 \\ 2x - y &= 3 \end{aligned}$$` → $$\begin{aligned} x + y &= 1 \\ 2x - y &= 3 \end{aligned}$$ (对齐方程组)
• `$$\left\{\begin{array}{l} x > 0 \\ y > 0 \end{array}\right.$$` → $$\left\{\begin{array}{l} x > 0 \\ y > 0 \end{array}\right.$$ (条件组)
content.en-US:
**Equation System Notation**

• `$$\begin{cases} x + y = 1 \\ x - y = 0 \end{cases}$$` → $$\begin{cases} x + y = 1 \\ x - y = 0 \end{cases}$$ (binary equation system)
• `$$\begin{aligned} x + y &= 1 \\ 2x - y &= 3 \end{aligned}$$` → $$\begin{aligned} x + y &= 1 \\ 2x - y &= 3 \end{aligned}$$ (aligned equation system)
• `$$\left\{\begin{array}{l} x > 0 \\ y > 0 \end{array}\right.$$` → $$\left\{\begin{array}{l} x > 0 \\ y > 0 \end{array}\right.$$ (condition group)

content.zh-CN:
**不等式符号**

• `$<$` → $<$ (小于)
• `$>$` → $>$ (大于)
• `$\leq$` → $\leq$ (小于等于)
• `$\geq$` → $\geq$ (大于等于)
• `$\ll$` → $\ll$ (远小于)
• `$\gg$` → $\gg$ (远大于)
• `$\subset$` → $\subset$ (子集)
• `$\supset$` → $\supset$ (超集)
content.en-US:
**Inequality Symbols**

• `$<$` → $<$ (less than)
• `$>$` → $>$ (greater than)
• `$\leq$` → $\leq$ (less than or equal)
• `$\geq$` → $\geq$ (greater than or equal)
• `$\ll$` → $\ll$ (much less than)
• `$\gg$` → $\gg$ (much greater than)
• `$\subset$` → $\subset$ (subset)
• `$\supset$` → $\supset$ (superset)

content.zh-CN:
**分段函数（cases 环境）**

• `$f(x) = \begin{cases} x & \text{if } x \geq 0 \\ -x & \text{if } x < 0 \end{cases}$` → $f(x) = \begin{cases} x & \text{if } x \geq 0 \\ -x & \text{if } x < 0 \end{cases}$ (绝对值的分段表示)
• cases 环境自动在左侧加上大括号，每行用 `\\` 分隔
• 行内用 `&` 分隔「表达式」与「条件」两列，条件文字要用 `\text{}` 包围
content.en-US:
**Piecewise Functions (cases environment)**

• `$f(x) = \begin{cases} x & \text{if } x \geq 0 \\ -x & \text{if } x < 0 \end{cases}$` → $f(x) = \begin{cases} x & \text{if } x \geq 0 \\ -x & \text{if } x < 0 \end{cases}$ (piecewise definition of absolute value)
• The cases environment automatically adds a left brace; separate rows with `\\`
• Use `&` inside a row to split the expression column and the condition column; wrap condition words in `\text{}`

content.zh-CN:
**多行推导（aligned 与 array）**

• `$$\begin{aligned} f(x) &= (x+1)^2 \\ &= x^2 + 2x + 1 \end{aligned}$$` → $$\begin{aligned} f(x) &= (x+1)^2 \\ &= x^2 + 2x + 1 \end{aligned}$$ (按等号对齐的推导)
• `$$\begin{array}{l} x > 0 \\ y > 0 \end{array}$$` → $$\begin{array}{l} x > 0 \\ y > 0 \end{array}$$ (左对齐的多行条件)
• aligned 在 `&` 处对齐，array 用 `{l}`/`{c}`/`{r}` 指定每列对齐方式
content.en-US:
**Multi-line Derivations (aligned & array)**

• `$$\begin{aligned} f(x) &= (x+1)^2 \\ &= x^2 + 2x + 1 \end{aligned}$$` → $$\begin{aligned} f(x) &= (x+1)^2 \\ &= x^2 + 2x + 1 \end{aligned}$$ (derivation aligned at equals signs)
• `$$\begin{array}{l} x > 0 \\ y > 0 \end{array}$$` → $$\begin{array}{l} x > 0 \\ y > 0 \end{array}$$ (left-aligned multi-line conditions)
• aligned aligns at `&`; array uses `{l}`/`{c}`/`{r}` to set each column's alignment

title.zh-CN: 第12课：概率统计与信息论

description.zh-CN: 学习概率统计与信息论核心公式的LaTeX表示，涵盖条件概率、贝叶斯定理、期望与方差、二项分布、泊松分布、正态分布、协方差与相关系数、最大似然估计、假设检验、信息熵与KL散度。
description.en-US: Learn LaTeX representation of core probability, statistics and information theory formulas, covering conditional probability, Bayes' theorem, expectation and variance, binomial, Poisson and normal distributions, covariance and correlation, maximum likelihood estimation, hypothesis testing, entropy and KL divergence.

content.zh-CN:
**概率基础与贝叶斯定理**

• `$P(A \mid B)$` → $P(A \mid B)$ (条件概率，\mid 显示条件竖线)
• `$P(A \mid B) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)}$` → $P(A \mid B) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)}$ (条件概率定义)
• `$P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B)$` → $P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B)$ (加法公式)
• `$P(B) = \sum_{i} P(B \mid A_i) P(A_i)$` → $P(B) = \sum_{i} P(B \mid A_i) P(A_i)$ (全概率公式)
• `$P(A \mid B) = \frac{P(B \mid A) P(A)}{P(B)}$` → $P(A \mid B) = \frac{P(B \mid A) P(A)}{P(B)}$ (贝叶斯定理)
content.en-US:
**Probability Basics & Bayes' Theorem**

• `$P(A \mid B)$` → $P(A \mid B)$ (conditional probability; \mid renders the conditioning bar)
• `$P(A \mid B) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)}$` → $P(A \mid B) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)}$ (definition of conditional probability)
• `$P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B)$` → $P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B)$ (addition rule)
• `$P(B) = \sum_{i} P(B \mid A_i) P(A_i)$` → $P(B) = \sum_{i} P(B \mid A_i) P(A_i)$ (law of total probability)
• `$P(A \mid B) = \frac{P(B \mid A) P(A)}{P(B)}$` → $P(A \mid B) = \frac{P(B \mid A) P(A)}{P(B)}$ (Bayes' theorem)

content.zh-CN:
**随机变量与数字特征**

• `$\mathbb{E}[X] = \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i p_i$` → $\mathbb{E}[X] = \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i p_i$ (离散型随机变量的期望)
• `$\operatorname{Var}(X) = \mathbb{E}[X^2] - (\mathbb{E}[X])^2$` → $\operatorname{Var}(X) = \mathbb{E}[X^2] - (\mathbb{E}[X])^2$ (方差的计算公式)
• `$\sigma = \sqrt{\operatorname{Var}(X)}$` → $\sigma = \sqrt{\operatorname{Var}(X)}$ (标准差)
• `$\operatorname{Cov}(X, Y) = \mathbb{E}[(X - \mathbb{E}[X])(Y - \mathbb{E}[Y])]$` → $\operatorname{Cov}(X, Y) = \mathbb{E}[(X - \mathbb{E}[X])(Y - \mathbb{E}[Y])]$ (协方差)
• `$\rho_{XY} = \frac{\operatorname{Cov}(X, Y)}{\sigma_X \sigma_Y}$` → $\rho_{XY} = \frac{\operatorname{Cov}(X, Y)}{\sigma_X \sigma_Y}$ (相关系数)
content.en-US:
**Random Variables & Moments**

• `$\mathbb{E}[X] = \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i p_i$` → $\mathbb{E}[X] = \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i p_i$ (expectation of a discrete random variable)
• `$\operatorname{Var}(X) = \mathbb{E}[X^2] - (\mathbb{E}[X])^2$` → $\operatorname{Var}(X) = \mathbb{E}[X^2] - (\mathbb{E}[X])^2$ (computational formula for variance)
• `$\sigma = \sqrt{\operatorname{Var}(X)}$` → $\sigma = \sqrt{\operatorname{Var}(X)}$ (standard deviation)
• `$\operatorname{Cov}(X, Y) = \mathbb{E}[(X - \mathbb{E}[X])(Y - \mathbb{E}[Y])]$` → $\operatorname{Cov}(X, Y) = \mathbb{E}[(X - \mathbb{E}[X])(Y - \mathbb{E}[Y])]$ (covariance)
• `$\rho_{XY} = \frac{\operatorname{Cov}(X, Y)}{\sigma_X \sigma_Y}$` → $\rho_{XY} = \frac{\operatorname{Cov}(X, Y)}{\sigma_X \sigma_Y}$ (correlation coefficient)

content.zh-CN:
**常见概率分布**

• `$X \sim B(n, p)$` → $X \sim B(n, p)$ (二项分布)
• `$P(X = k) = \binom{n}{k} p^k (1-p)^{n-k}$` → $P(X = k) = \binom{n}{k} p^k (1-p)^{n-k}$ (二项分布概率质量函数)
• `$P(X = k) = \frac{\lambda^k e^{-\lambda}}{k!}$` → $P(X = k) = \frac{\lambda^k e^{-\lambda}}{k!}$ (泊松分布)
• `$X \sim N(\mu, \sigma^2)$` → $X \sim N(\mu, \sigma^2)$ (正态分布)
• `$f(x) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\sigma} e^{-\frac{(x-\mu)^2}{2\sigma^2}}$` → $f(x) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\sigma} e^{-\frac{(x-\mu)^2}{2\sigma^2}}$ (正态分布密度函数)
content.en-US:
**Common Probability Distributions**

• `$X \sim B(n, p)$` → $X \sim B(n, p)$ (binomial distribution)
• `$P(X = k) = \binom{n}{k} p^k (1-p)^{n-k}$` → $P(X = k) = \binom{n}{k} p^k (1-p)^{n-k}$ (binomial probability mass function)
• `$P(X = k) = \frac{\lambda^k e^{-\lambda}}{k!}$` → $P(X = k) = \frac{\lambda^k e^{-\lambda}}{k!}$ (Poisson distribution)
• `$X \sim N(\mu, \sigma^2)$` → $X \sim N(\mu, \sigma^2)$ (normal distribution)
• `$f(x) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\sigma} e^{-\frac{(x-\mu)^2}{2\sigma^2}}$` → $f(x) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\sigma} e^{-\frac{(x-\mu)^2}{2\sigma^2}}$ (normal density function)

content.zh-CN:
**信息论与假设检验**

• `$H(X) = -\sum_{i=1}^{n} p_i \log_2 p_i$` → $H(X) = -\sum_{i=1}^{n} p_i \log_2 p_i$ (信息熵)
• `$D_{KL}(P \| Q) = \sum_{x} P(x) \log \frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}$` → $D_{KL}(P \| Q) = \sum_{x} P(x) \log \frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}$ (KL 散度)
• `$z = \frac{\bar{x} - \mu_0}{\sigma / \sqrt{n}}$` → $z = \frac{\bar{x} - \mu_0}{\sigma / \sqrt{n}}$ (z 检验统计量)
• `$p < 0.05$` → $p < 0.05$ (常用的显著性水平判断)
content.en-US:
**Information Theory & Hypothesis Testing**

• `$H(X) = -\sum_{i=1}^{n} p_i \log_2 p_i$` → $H(X) = -\sum_{i=1}^{n} p_i \log_2 p_i$ (information entropy)
• `$D_{KL}(P \| Q) = \sum_{x} P(x) \log \frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}$` → $D_{KL}(P \| Q) = \sum_{x} P(x) \log \frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}$ (KL divergence)
• `$z = \frac{\bar{x} - \mu_0}{\sigma / \sqrt{n}}$` → $z = \frac{\bar{x} - \mu_0}{\sigma / \sqrt{n}}$ (z-test statistic)
• `$p < 0.05$` → $p < 0.05$ (common significance-level criterion)

description.zh-CN: 学习线性代数进阶内容的LaTeX表示，涵盖矩阵转置、逆矩阵、行列式、迹、特征方程、特征分解、秩、正交矩阵、投影矩阵、奇异值分解、向量范数与Kronecker积。
description.en-US: Learn LaTeX representation of advanced linear algebra, covering matrix transpose, inverse, determinant, trace, characteristic equation, eigendecomposition, rank, orthogonal matrices, projection, singular value decomposition, vector norms and the Kronecker product.

content.zh-CN:
**矩阵运算**

• `$(AB)^T = B^T A^T$` → $(AB)^T = B^T A^T$ (乘积的转置)
• `$(AB)^{-1} = B^{-1} A^{-1}$` → $(AB)^{-1} = B^{-1} A^{-1}$ (乘积的逆)
• `$\det(AB) = \det(A) \det(B)$` → $\det(AB) = \det(A) \det(B)$ (乘积的行列式)
• `$\operatorname{tr}(A) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{ii}$` → $\operatorname{tr}(A) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{ii}$ (迹等于对角元之和)
• `$A^{-1} = \frac{1}{\det(A)} \operatorname{adj}(A)$` → $A^{-1} = \frac{1}{\det(A)} \operatorname{adj}(A)$ (伴随矩阵求逆)
content.en-US:
**Matrix Operations**

• `$(AB)^T = B^T A^T$` → $(AB)^T = B^T A^T$ (transpose of a product)
• `$(AB)^{-1} = B^{-1} A^{-1}$` → $(AB)^{-1} = B^{-1} A^{-1}$ (inverse of a product)
• `$\det(AB) = \det(A) \det(B)$` → $\det(AB) = \det(A) \det(B)$ (determinant of a product)
• `$\operatorname{tr}(A) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{ii}$` → $\operatorname{tr}(A) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{ii}$ (trace equals the sum of diagonal entries)
• `$A^{-1} = \frac{1}{\det(A)} \operatorname{adj}(A)$` → $A^{-1} = \frac{1}{\det(A)} \operatorname{adj}(A)$ (inverse via the adjugate)

content.zh-CN:
**特征值、特征分解与秩**

• `$A v = \lambda v$` → $A v = \lambda v$ (特征方程，v 为特征向量)
• `$\det(A - \lambda I) = 0$` → $\det(A - \lambda I) = 0$ (特征多项式方程)
• `$A = P \Lambda P^{-1}$` → $A = P \Lambda P^{-1}$ (特征分解)
• `$A^k = P \Lambda^k P^{-1}$` → $A^k = P \Lambda^k P^{-1}$ (矩阵幂)
• `$\operatorname{rank}(A) + \operatorname{nullity}(A) = n$` → $\operatorname{rank}(A) + \operatorname{nullity}(A) = n$ (秩-零化度定理)
content.en-US:
**Eigenvalues, Eigendecomposition & Rank**

• `$A v = \lambda v$` → $A v = \lambda v$ (eigenvalue equation, v is an eigenvector)
• `$\det(A - \lambda I) = 0$` → $\det(A - \lambda I) = 0$ (characteristic polynomial equation)
• `$A = P \Lambda P^{-1}$` → $A = P \Lambda P^{-1}$ (eigendecomposition)
• `$A^k = P \Lambda^k P^{-1}$` → $A^k = P \Lambda^k P^{-1}$ (matrix power)
• `$\operatorname{rank}(A) + \operatorname{nullity}(A) = n$` → $\operatorname{rank}(A) + \operatorname{nullity}(A) = n$ (rank-nullity theorem)

content.zh-CN:
**正交、投影与奇异值分解**

• `$Q^T Q = Q Q^T = I$` → $Q^T Q = Q Q^T = I$ (正交矩阵定义)
• `$Q^{-1} = Q^T$` → $Q^{-1} = Q^T$ (正交矩阵的逆等于转置)
• `$P = A(A^T A)^{-1} A^T$` → $P = A(A^T A)^{-1} A^T$ (列空间投影矩阵)
• `$P^2 = P$` → $P^2 = P$ (投影矩阵幂等)
• `$A = U \Sigma V^T$` → $A = U \Sigma V^T$ (奇异值分解 SVD)
content.en-US:
**Orthogonality, Projection & SVD**

• `$Q^T Q = Q Q^T = I$` → $Q^T Q = Q Q^T = I$ (definition of an orthogonal matrix)
• `$Q^{-1} = Q^T$` → $Q^{-1} = Q^T$ (inverse of an orthogonal matrix equals its transpose)
• `$P = A(A^T A)^{-1} A^T$` → $P = A(A^T A)^{-1} A^T$ (projection onto the column space)
• `$P^2 = P$` → $P^2 = P$ (projection matrices are idempotent)
• `$A = U \Sigma V^T$` → $A = U \Sigma V^T$ (singular value decomposition)

content.zh-CN:
**范数与 Kronecker 积**

• `$\|x\|_1 = \sum_{i=1}^{n} |x_i|$` → $\|x\|_1 = \sum_{i=1}^{n} |x_i|$ (1-范数)
• `$\|x\|_2 = \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i^2}$` → $\|x\|_2 = \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i^2}$ (2-范数)
• `$\|x\|_\infty = \max_{i} |x_i|$` → $\|x\|_\infty = \max_{i} |x_i|$ (无穷范数)
• `$\|A\|_F = \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^{m} \sum_{j=1}^{n} a_{ij}^2}$` → $\|A\|_F = \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^{m} \sum_{j=1}^{n} a_{ij}^2}$ (Frobenius 范数)
• Kronecker 积的分块形式：$$A \otimes B = \begin{pmatrix} a_{11} B & a_{12} B \\ a_{21} B & a_{22} B \end{pmatrix}$$
content.en-US:
**Norms & the Kronecker Product**

• `$\|x\|_1 = \sum_{i=1}^{n} |x_i|$` → $\|x\|_1 = \sum_{i=1}^{n} |x_i|$ (1-norm)
• `$\|x\|_2 = \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i^2}$` → $\|x\|_2 = \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i^2}$ (2-norm)
• `$\|x\|_\infty = \max_{i} |x_i|$` → $\|x\|_\infty = \max_{i} |x_i|$ (infinity norm)
• `$\|A\|_F = \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^{m} \sum_{j=1}^{n} a_{ij}^2}$` → $\|A\|_F = \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^{m} \sum_{j=1}^{n} a_{ij}^2}$ (Frobenius norm)
• Block form of the Kronecker product: $$A \otimes B = \begin{pmatrix} a_{11} B & a_{12} B \\ a_{21} B & a_{22} B \end{pmatrix}$$

description.zh-CN: 学习物理与工程经典公式的LaTeX表示，涵盖牛顿第二定律、万有引力定律、动能与势能、麦克斯韦方程组、薛定谔方程、洛伦兹力、欧姆定律、傅里叶变换、简谐振子与质能方程。
description.en-US: Learn LaTeX representation of classic physics and engineering formulas, covering Newton's second law, universal gravitation, kinetic and potential energy, Maxwell's equations, the Schrödinger equation, the Lorentz force, Ohm's law, the Fourier transform, the harmonic oscillator and mass-energy equivalence.

content.zh-CN:
**经典力学公式**

• `$F = ma$` → $F = ma$ (牛顿第二定律)
• `$F = G \frac{m_1 m_2}{r^2}$` → $F = G \frac{m_1 m_2}{r^2}$ (万有引力定律)
• `$E_k = \frac{1}{2} m v^2$` → $E_k = \frac{1}{2} m v^2$ (动能)
• `$E_p = mgh$` → $E_p = mgh$ (重力势能)
• `$E = mc^2$` → $E = mc^2$ (质能方程)
• `$F = -kx$` → $F = -kx$ (胡克定律)
content.en-US:
**Classical Mechanics Formulas**

• `$F = ma$` → $F = ma$ (Newton's second law)
• `$F = G \frac{m_1 m_2}{r^2}$` → $F = G \frac{m_1 m_2}{r^2}$ (law of universal gravitation)
• `$E_k = \frac{1}{2} m v^2$` → $E_k = \frac{1}{2} m v^2$ (kinetic energy)
• `$E_p = mgh$` → $E_p = mgh$ (gravitational potential energy)
• `$E = mc^2$` → $E = mc^2$ (mass-energy equivalence)
• `$F = -kx$` → $F = -kx$ (Hooke's law)

content.zh-CN:
**电动力学公式**

• `$U = IR$` → $U = IR$ (欧姆定律)
• `$\mathbf{F} = q(\mathbf{E} + \mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})$` → $\mathbf{F} = q(\mathbf{E} + \mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})$ (洛伦兹力)
• `$\nabla \cdot \mathbf{E} = \frac{\rho}{\varepsilon_0}$` → $\nabla \cdot \mathbf{E} = \frac{\rho}{\varepsilon_0}$ (高斯定律，微分形式)
• `$\nabla \times \mathbf{B} = \mu_0 \mathbf{J} + \mu_0 \varepsilon_0 \frac{\partial \mathbf{E}}{\partial t}$` → $\nabla \times \mathbf{B} = \mu_0 \mathbf{J} + \mu_0 \varepsilon_0 \frac{\partial \mathbf{E}}{\partial t}$ (安培-麦克斯韦定律)
content.en-US:
**Electrodynamics Formulas**

• `$U = IR$` → $U = IR$ (Ohm's law)
• `$\mathbf{F} = q(\mathbf{E} + \mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})$` → $\mathbf{F} = q(\mathbf{E} + \mathbf{v} \times \mathbf{B})$ (Lorentz force)
• `$\nabla \cdot \mathbf{E} = \frac{\rho}{\varepsilon_0}$` → $\nabla \cdot \mathbf{E} = \frac{\rho}{\varepsilon_0}$ (Gauss's law, differential form)
• `$\nabla \times \mathbf{B} = \mu_0 \mathbf{J} + \mu_0 \varepsilon_0 \frac{\partial \mathbf{E}}{\partial t}$` → $\nabla \times \mathbf{B} = \mu_0 \mathbf{J} + \mu_0 \varepsilon_0 \frac{\partial \mathbf{E}}{\partial t}$ (Ampere-Maxwell law)

content.zh-CN:
**量子力学公式**

• `$i\hbar \frac{\partial}{\partial t} \Psi = \hat{H} \Psi$` → $i\hbar \frac{\partial}{\partial t} \Psi = \hat{H} \Psi$ (含时薛定谔方程)
• `$\hat{H} \psi = E \psi$` → $\hat{H} \psi = E \psi$ (定态薛定谔方程)
• `$[\hat{x}, \hat{p}] = i\hbar$` → $[\hat{x}, \hat{p}] = i\hbar$ (正则对易关系)
• `$\Delta x \, \Delta p \geq \frac{\hbar}{2}$` → $\Delta x \, \Delta p \geq \frac{\hbar}{2}$ (不确定性原理)
content.en-US:
**Quantum Mechanics Formulas**

• `$i\hbar \frac{\partial}{\partial t} \Psi = \hat{H} \Psi$` → $i\hbar \frac{\partial}{\partial t} \Psi = \hat{H} \Psi$ (time-dependent Schrodinger equation)
• `$\hat{H} \psi = E \psi$` → $\hat{H} \psi = E \psi$ (time-independent Schrodinger equation)
• `$[\hat{x}, \hat{p}] = i\hbar$` → $[\hat{x}, \hat{p}] = i\hbar$ (canonical commutation relation)

• `$\omega = \sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}$` → $\omega = \sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}$ (弹簧振子角频率)
• `$x(t) = A \cos(\omega t + \varphi)$` → $x(t) = A \cos(\omega t + \varphi)$ (简谐振动)
• `$T = 2\pi \sqrt{\frac{l}{g}}$` → $T = 2\pi \sqrt{\frac{l}{g}}$ (单摆周期)
• `$E_n = \hbar\omega \left(n + \frac{1}{2}\right)$` → $E_n = \hbar\omega \left(n + \frac{1}{2}\right)$ (量子谐振子能级)
content.en-US:
**Transform & Oscillation Formulas**

• `$F(\omega) = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} f(t) e^{-i\omega t} \, dt$` → $F(\omega) = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} f(t) e^{-i\omega t} \, dt$ (Fourier transform)

• `$x(t) = A \cos(\omega t + \varphi)$` → $x(t) = A \cos(\omega t + \varphi)$ (simple harmonic motion)
• `$T = 2\pi \sqrt{\frac{l}{g}}$` → $T = 2\pi \sqrt{\frac{l}{g}}$ (period of a simple pendulum)
• `$E_n = \hbar\omega \left(n + \frac{1}{2}\right)$` → $E_n = \hbar\omega \left(n + \frac{1}{2}\right)$ (energy levels of the quantum harmonic oscillator)

title.zh-CN: 第15课：复变函数与积分变换

description.zh-CN: 本课覆盖复变函数与积分变换的核心公式：虚数单位、欧拉公式、共轭与模、柯西-黎曼方程、柯西积分公式、留数定理、拉普拉斯变换、Z 变换、卷积、傅里叶级数以及黎曼 ζ 函数。
description.en-US: This lesson covers the core formulas of complex analysis and integral transforms: the imaginary unit, Euler's formula, conjugate and modulus, the Cauchy-Riemann equations, Cauchy's integral formula, the residue theorem, the Laplace transform, the Z transform, convolution, Fourier series, and the Riemann zeta function.

content.zh-CN:
**复数与欧拉公式**

• 虚数单位满足 `$i^2 = -1$`
• 复数 $z = a + bi$ 的共轭为 $\bar{z} = a - bi$，模为 $|z| = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2}$
• 欧拉公式：$e^{i\theta} = \cos\theta + i\sin\theta$，特别地 $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$
content.en-US:
**Complex Numbers and Euler's Formula**

• The imaginary unit satisfies `$i^2 = -1$`
• For $z = a + bi$, the conjugate is $\bar{z} = a - bi$ and the modulus is $|z| = \sqrt{a^2 + b^2}$
• Euler's formula: $e^{i\theta} = \cos\theta + i\sin\theta$; in particular $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$

content.zh-CN:
**解析函数与留数**

• 柯西-黎曼方程：$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial v}{\partial y}$ 且 $\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = -\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}$
• 柯西积分公式：$$f(a) = \frac{1}{2\pi i}\oint_C \frac{f(z)}{z-a}\,dz$$
• 留数定理把环路积分化为留数之和：$$\oint_C f(z)\,dz = 2\pi i \sum_{k=1}^{n} \operatorname{Res}(f, z_k)$$
content.en-US:
**Analytic Functions and Residues**

• Cauchy-Riemann equations: $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial v}{\partial y}$ and $\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = -\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}$
• Cauchy's integral formula: $$f(a) = \frac{1}{2\pi i}\oint_C \frac{f(z)}{z-a}\,dz$$
• The residue theorem turns a contour integral into a sum of residues: $$\oint_C f(z)\,dz = 2\pi i \sum_{k=1}^{n} \operatorname{Res}(f, z_k)$$

content.zh-CN:
**积分变换与卷积**

• 拉普拉斯变换：$$F(s) = \int_0^{\infty} f(t)e^{-st}\,dt$$
• 双边 Z 变换：$$X(z) = \sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x[n]z^{-n}$$
• 卷积：$$(f * g)(t) = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} f(\tau)g(t-\tau)\,d\tau$$
content.en-US:
**Integral Transforms and Convolution**

• Laplace transform: $$F(s) = \int_0^{\infty} f(t)e^{-st}\,dt$$
• Bilateral Z transform: $$X(z) = \sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} x[n]z^{-n}$$
• Convolution: $$(f * g)(t) = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} f(\tau)g(t-\tau)\,d\tau$$

content.zh-CN:
**级数与特殊函数**

• 傅里叶级数：$$f(x) = \frac{a_0}{2} + \sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\left(a_n\cos nx + b_n\sin nx\right)$$
• 伽马函数：$\Gamma(s) = \int_0^{\infty} t^{s-1}e^{-t}\,dt$，对正整数 n 有 $\Gamma(n) = (n-1)!$
• 黎曼 ζ 函数：$\zeta(s) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n^s}$，例如 $\zeta(2) = \frac{\pi^2}{6}$
content.en-US:
**Series and Special Functions**

• Fourier series: $$f(x) = \frac{a_0}{2} + \sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\left(a_n\cos nx + b_n\sin nx\right)$$
• Gamma function: $\Gamma(s) = \int_0^{\infty} t^{s-1}e^{-t}\,dt$; for positive integers n, $\Gamma(n) = (n-1)!$
• Riemann zeta function: $\zeta(s) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n^s}$; for example $\zeta(2) = \frac{\pi^2}{6}$

description.zh-CN: 本课覆盖离散数学与算法分析的核心记号：大 O 记号、主定理、递推关系、生成函数、容斥原理、图论度数和与欧拉公式、邻接矩阵、布尔代数、快速幂以及斯特林数。
description.en-US: This lesson covers the core notation of discrete mathematics and algorithm analysis: big O notation, the master theorem, recurrence relations, generating functions, inclusion-exclusion, the handshaking lemma and Euler's formula in graph theory, adjacency matrices, Boolean algebra, fast exponentiation, and Stirling numbers.

content.zh-CN:
**大 O 记号与主定理**

• 渐近上界写成等式形式：$f(n) = O(g(n))$
• 主定理适用于形如 $$T(n) = aT\left(\frac{n}{b}\right) + f(n)$$ 的分治递推，其中 $a \geq 1$、$b > 1$
content.en-US:
**Big O Notation and the Master Theorem**

• The asymptotic upper bound is written as an equation: $f(n) = O(g(n))$
• The master theorem applies to divide-and-conquer recurrences of the form $$T(n) = aT\left(\frac{n}{b}\right) + f(n)$$ where $a \geq 1$ and $b > 1$

content.zh-CN:
**递推关系与生成函数**

• 斐波那契数列的递推关系：$F_n = F_{n-1} + F_{n-2}$
• 序列 $a_0, a_1, a_2, \ldots$ 的普通生成函数定义为 $$G(x) = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a_n x^n$$
content.en-US:
**Recurrence Relations and Generating Functions**

• The recurrence for the Fibonacci sequence: $F_n = F_{n-1} + F_{n-2}$
• The ordinary generating function of a sequence $a_0, a_1, a_2, \ldots$ is defined as $$G(x) = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a_n x^n$$

content.zh-CN:
**图论计数**

• 度数和公式（握手引理）：$\sum_{v \in V} \deg(v) = 2|E|$
• 连通平面图的欧拉公式：$V - E + F = 2$
• 两个集合的容斥原理：$|A \cup B| = |A| + |B| - |A \cap B|$
• 邻接矩阵 $A$ 的 k 次幂中，$(A^k)_{ij}$ 给出从顶点 i 到顶点 j 的长度为 k 的途径数
content.en-US:
**Counting in Graph Theory**

• The handshaking lemma: $\sum_{v \in V} \deg(v) = 2|E|$
• Euler's formula for a connected planar graph: $V - E + F = 2$
• Inclusion-exclusion for two sets: $|A \cup B| = |A| + |B| - |A \cap B|$
• In the k-th power of the adjacency matrix $A$, the entry $(A^k)_{ij}$ gives the number of walks of length k from vertex i to vertex j

content.zh-CN:
**布尔代数与算法技巧**

• 德摩根定律：$\neg(A \land B) = \neg A \lor \neg B$
• 快速幂的偶数情形：$a^n = \left(a^{n/2}\right)^2$
• 第二类斯特林数的递推：$S(n,k) = kS(n-1,k) + S(n-1,k-1)$
content.en-US:
**Boolean Algebra and Algorithmic Tricks**

• De Morgan's law: $\neg(A \land B) = \neg A \lor \neg B$
• Fast exponentiation, even case: $a^n = \left(a^{n/2}\right)^2$
• Recurrence for Stirling numbers of the second kind: $S(n,k) = kS(n-1,k) + S(n-1,k-1)$

title.zh-CN: 第17课：微分方程与偏微分方程

description.zh-CN: 本课覆盖常微分方程与偏微分方程的核心写法：一阶线性方程、分离变量、二阶常系数方程与特征方程、初值问题、拉普拉斯方程、热方程、波动方程、边界条件以及 Navier-Stokes 方程。
description.en-US: This lesson covers the core formulas of ordinary and partial differential equations: first-order linear equations, separation of variables, second-order constant-coefficient equations and their characteristic equation, initial value problems, the Laplace equation, the heat equation, the wave equation, boundary conditions, and the Navier-Stokes equations.

content.zh-CN:
**一阶常微分方程**

• 一阶线性方程的标准形式：$\frac{dy}{dx} + P(x)y = Q(x)$
• 可分离变量的方程写成 $\frac{dy}{dx} = f(x)g(y)$，分离后两边积分：$\int \frac{dy}{g(y)} = \int f(x)\,dx$
• 积分因子法：两边同乘 $\mu(x) = e^{\int P(x)\,dx}$，左边化为乘积的导数
content.en-US:
**First-Order Ordinary Differential Equations**

• Standard form of a first-order linear equation: $\frac{dy}{dx} + P(x)y = Q(x)$
• A separable equation reads $\frac{dy}{dx} = f(x)g(y)$; separate and integrate both sides: $\int \frac{dy}{g(y)} = \int f(x)\,dx$
• Integrating factor method: multiply both sides by $\mu(x) = e^{\int P(x)\,dx}$ so the left side becomes the derivative of a product

content.zh-CN:
**二阶常系数线性方程**

• 齐次方程：$ay'' + by' + cy = 0$
• 特征方程：$ar^2 + br + c = 0$
• 有两个不同实根 $r_1$、$r_2$ 时，通解为 $y = C_1 e^{r_1 x} + C_2 e^{r_2 x}$
• 初值问题额外给定 $y(x_0) = y_0, \quad y'(x_0) = y_1$
content.en-US:
**Second-Order Constant-Coefficient Linear Equations**

• Homogeneous equation: $ay'' + by' + cy = 0$
• Characteristic equation: $ar^2 + br + c = 0$
• With two distinct real roots $r_1$ and $r_2$, the general solution is $y = C_1 e^{r_1 x} + C_2 e^{r_2 x}$
• An initial value problem also prescribes $y(x_0) = y_0, \quad y'(x_0) = y_1$

content.zh-CN:
**经典偏微分方程**

• 拉普拉斯方程（稳态）：$\nabla^2 u = 0$
• 一维热方程（扩散）：$\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} = \alpha \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}$
• 一维波动方程：$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2} = c^2 \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}$
content.en-US:
**Classical Partial Differential Equations**

• Laplace equation (steady state): $\nabla^2 u = 0$
• One-dimensional heat equation (diffusion): $\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} = \alpha \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}$
• One-dimensional wave equation: $\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2} = c^2 \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}$

content.zh-CN:
**边界条件与 Navier-Stokes 方程**

• 狄利克雷边界条件给定边界上的函数值：$u|_{\partial\Omega} = f$
• 诺伊曼边界条件给定法向导数：$\frac{\partial u}{\partial n}\Big|_{\partial\Omega} = g$
• 不可压缩黏性流动的动量方程（Navier-Stokes）：
$$\rho\left(\frac{\partial \mathbf{u}}{\partial t} + \mathbf{u}\cdot\nabla\mathbf{u}\right) = -\nabla p + \mu\nabla^2\mathbf{u} + \mathbf{f}$$
content.en-US:
**Boundary Conditions and the Navier-Stokes Equations**

• A Dirichlet boundary condition prescribes the value on the boundary: $u|_{\partial\Omega} = f$
• A Neumann boundary condition prescribes the normal derivative: $\frac{\partial u}{\partial n}\Big|_{\partial\Omega} = g$
• The momentum equation of incompressible viscous flow (Navier-Stokes):
$$\rho\left(\frac{\partial \mathbf{u}}{\partial t} + \mathbf{u}\cdot\nabla\mathbf{u}\right) = -\nabla p + \mu\nabla^2\mathbf{u} + \mathbf{f}$$

description.zh-CN: 本课覆盖高级数学排版技巧：aligned 多行对齐、\left 与 \right 伸缩括号、\substack/\overset/\underset 上下标注、\text/\mathrm/\operatorname 文本与函数名、array 与 vmatrix 环境、\, \; \quad 间距命令、\displaystyle 展示样式以及 \boxed 框选结果。
description.en-US: This lesson covers advanced mathematical typesetting: multi-line alignment with aligned, stretchy delimiters with \left and \right, stacking annotations with \substack/\overset/\underset, text and function names with \text/\mathrm/\operatorname, the array and vmatrix environments, spacing commands \, \; \quad, the \displaystyle switch, and boxing results with \boxed.

content.zh-CN:
**多行公式：aligned 与 array**

• `aligned` 环境用 `&` 设定对齐点、用 `\\` 换行：
$$\begin{aligned} x + y &= 1 \\ x - y &= 3 \end{aligned}$$
• `array` 环境还要声明列格式，例如 `{cc}` 表示两列居中：$$\begin{array}{cc} a & b \\ c & d \end{array}$$
content.en-US:
**Multi-line Formulas: aligned and array**

• The `aligned` environment uses `&` for alignment points and `\\` for line breaks:
$$\begin{aligned} x + y &= 1 \\ x - y &= 3 \end{aligned}$$
• The `array` environment also declares a column format, e.g. `{cc}` for two centered columns: $$\begin{array}{cc} a & b \\ c & d \end{array}$$

content.zh-CN:
**伸缩括号与上下标注**

• `\left` 与 `\right` 让括号随内容高度伸缩：$\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)$；分段函数右侧用不可见定界符 `\right.`
• `\substack` 把多行条件堆进求和下标：$\sum_{\substack{i=1 \\ i \neq j}}^{n} a_i$
• `\overset` 在上方、`\underset` 在下方加注：$A \overset{f}{\to} B$、$\underset{n \to \infty}{\lim} a_n = 0$
content.en-US:
**Stretchy Delimiters and Stacked Annotations**

• `\left` and `\right` stretch delimiters to the height of their content: $\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)$; a piecewise function closes with the invisible delimiter `\right.`
• `\substack` stacks multi-line conditions under a sum: $\sum_{\substack{i=1 \\ i \neq j}}^{n} a_i$
• `\overset` annotates above and `\underset` below: $A \overset{f}{\to} B$, $\underset{n \to \infty}{\lim} a_n = 0$

content.zh-CN:
**文字、函数名与间距**

• `\text{}` 在公式中嵌入文字：$\text{if } x > 0 \text{ then } y = x$
• `\mathrm{}` 表示直立体符号，如微分号：$\mathrm{d}x$
• `\operatorname{}` 定义新函数名：$\operatorname{sgn}(x)$
• 间距命令由小到大：$a \, b$、$a \; b$、$a \quad b$
content.en-US:
**Text, Function Names and Spacing**

• `\text{}` embeds words inside a formula: $\text{if } x > 0 \text{ then } y = x$
• `\mathrm{}` sets upright symbols such as the differential: $\mathrm{d}x$
• `\operatorname{}` defines new function names: $\operatorname{sgn}(x)$
• Spacing commands from thin to wide: $a \, b$, $a \; b$, $a \quad b$

content.zh-CN:
**展示样式与框选结果**

• `\displaystyle` 让行内位置的分式与求和上下限按展示公式尺寸排版：$\displaystyle\int_0^1 x^2\,dx = \frac{1}{3}$
• `\boxed{}` 给最终答案加方框：$\boxed{x = \pm 1}$
content.en-US:
**Display Style and Boxed Results**

• `\displaystyle` renders fractions and sum limits at display size even inline: $\displaystyle\int_0^1 x^2\,dx = \frac{1}{3}$
• `\boxed{}` puts a frame around the final answer: $\boxed{x = \pm 1}$
